name: Odomos Mosquito Repellent Fabric Rollon Citronella & Eucalyptus Oil | 8Ml | Made In India
description:
Product Name: Odomos Mosquito Repellent Fabric Roll-On 
Available Variants:

Roll-On: 8ml

Cream: 50gm / 100gm
Brand: Odomos
Made in: India
Type: 100% Ayurvedic Formula

Key Features & Benefits

Natural Protection: Made with Citronella & Eucalyptus Oil – safe, herbal, and effective against mosquitoes.

Clinically Tested: Proven efficacy, tested in Nable Lab for reliable protection.

Superior Composition: Ayurveda-based formulation, safe for adults and children.

Effective Shield: Protects against mosquito-borne diseases like Dengue, Malaria & Chikungunya.

Convenient Usage:

Roll-On: Easy-to-use, apply directly on clothes for up to 8 hours protection.

Cream: Non-sticky, gentle on skin, enriched with natural oils for day & night protection.
